result.summary: This PR marks the `replaceable` argument as deprecated across ten wallet and raw-transaction RPCs (createrawtransaction, fundrawtransaction, createpsbt, walletcreatefundedpsbt, send, sendtoaddress, sendmany, sendall, bumpfee, psbtbumpfee), requiring `-deprecatedrpc=bip125` to continue using it. It updates RPC help text, adds deprecation-error throws, updates release notes, and reworks the `wallet_deprecated_rbf.py` functional test to cover the new behavior across RPCs. It follows on from the earlier deprecation of the `bip125-replaceable` output field in PR #34917 and the closed PR #35405.
result.problem: Opt-in RBF signalling via the `replaceable` argument is now largely redundant since fullrbf has been the default network policy since Bitcoin Core v28, so the argument is dead weight for wallet RPC users and a maintenance burden for the project heading toward removal, per issue #32661.

result.card: This PR deprecates the `replaceable` argument across ten wallet and raw-transaction creation RPCs (createrawtransaction, fundrawtransaction, createpsbt, walletcreatefundedpsbt, send, sendtoaddress, sendmany, sendall, bumpfee, psbtbumpfee), requiring `-deprecatedrpc=bip125` to keep using it, continuing the project's move away from opt-in RBF signalling now that fullrbf is default network policy (issue #32661). It has a concept ACK from polespinasa, but the same reviewer's 2026-08-12 comments flag dropped test coverage for `replaceable=False`, possibly dead/duplicated deprecation-check code, and non-atomic commits, none of which have an author response yet. The PR needs a rebase (mergeable_state dirty) and has seen 20 force-pushes and 8 commits since June 2026, reflecting substantial rework already. It is not blocking or blocked by any other open PR directly but builds on the closed #35405 and interacts with the still-open #35442. Priority is moderate across wallet and rpc as a durable but non-urgent cleanup of a redundant user option, and low in docs and utils where the changes are incidental.
